title: Roblox Oof
blurb: A tiny, dusty grunt that became an entire generation's word for misfortune. The Roblox oof played on every death in the game for over a decade, which means millions of children heard it thousands of times during their formative years, hardwiring it in permanently. Then it was pulled in 2022 following a dispute over who actually owned the sound — and being banned only made it more beloved. Play it for any minor disaster: stubbed toes, failed exams, seeing the group project grade. Gaming's most efficient expression of defeat.
origin: Roblox's original death sound (2006–2022), retired from the game but immortal as a meme.
